تصطبنين (form VIII)
# تَصْطَبِنِينَ (taṣṭabinīna) /tasˤ.tˤa.bi.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# تُصْطَبَنِينَ (tuṣṭabanīna) /tusˤ.tˤa.ba.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
